caseName: Post Printing & Publishing Co. v. Shafroth
caseNameFull: The Post Printing & Publishing Company, in Error v. John F. Shafroth, as Governor, etc.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Colorado.
attorneys: Mr. Booth M. Malone for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Benjamin Griffith, Mr. Henry J. Hersey, Mr. F. A. Williams and Mr. Horace N. Hawkins for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam :

Dismissed for the. want of jurisdiction on the authority of Chappell Chemical Co. v. Sulphur Mines Co., 172 U. S. 465, 471.
